boundary: the platform allocator's own bound -- a direct realloc (libc), with no interpreter arena between it and the request
title: The same-address realloc stale-capability shape, as two upstream reductions (mruby Array#sort!, Perl HvAUX)
note: The realloc stale-capability probe (probe.c on CheriBSD, probe-capstone.c on the Capstone virtual profile) measures, in both platforms, what happens to a pointer kept across a realloc that keeps the same address. These two cases are the upstream defects of that exact shape, each a standalone case.c reduction with its fix predating the ported pin (mruby eb398971b in 4.0.0-rc2; Perl 4547997058 in 5.36.3), so live_in_pin is false like the FFmpeg fixed-before-pin corpora. Two arms carry measured verdicts (CheriBSD silent under both layers; the Capstone virtual revoking arm faults at the stale access); probe.c / probe-capstone.c are the runnable multi-platform instruments and this folder's README records every scenario's result lines.
